patches.name: Android Auto
patches.description: Adds an audio entry for YouTube to Android Auto. What YouTube plays in the background appears on the car screen with play, pause, skip and seek controls. Needs the background playback patch, and Android Auto's 'Unknown sources' developer setting unless the app was installed by the Play Store.

patches.name: Android Auto video
patches.description: Adds YouTube to Android Auto as a full app on the car screen: home, search, the player and its controls, used from the car's touchscreen. Video follows the car's own 'video allowed' signal. Android Auto only lists it when the patched app is installed with the Play Store as installer, for example with KingInstaller.
